task.name: Grand Mining Expedition - Five-Team Advanced Ore Processing
task.description: Five agents work together to establish a complete mining and smelting operation, producing advanced metal equipment through coordinated resource gathering and crafting

objectives.primary: Establish a complete mining-to-crafting pipeline with five specialized agents to produce advanced metal equipment
secondary: Coordinate five-agent mining expedition across multiple ore types
Execute advanced smelting operations with proper fuel management
Complete coordinated crafting of multiple equipment pieces
Achieve all objectives within 50 rounds with five-agent coordination

task_definition.relevant_game_context:
This is a large-scale cooperative multi-agent mining and crafting scenario requiring complex five-agent coordination.

GRAND OBJECTIVE: Work together as a team of 5 agents to establish a complete mining operation:
1. Mine iron ore and coal from different locations
2. Smelt iron bars through coordinated fuel management
3. Craft multiple equipment pieces (pickaxe, axe, heavy sword)
4. Distribute equipment among team members for enhanced capabilities

FIVE-AGENT COORDINATION REQUIREMENTS:
- Use global chat extensively to communicate mining progress and locations
- Self-organize into specialized roles: iron miners, coal miners, smelters, crafters, and logistics
- Share resources efficiently between all five agents
- Coordinate locations to enable successful transfers between all team members
- Leverage each agent's mining and crafting skills across all projects
- Complete all objectives within the time limit through perfect coordination

MINING OPERATIONS:
⛏️ Mining - Iron Ore:
  - harvest_resource on Iron Rock instances to get ironore
  - Level required: 10+ (Mining skill)
  - Tool required: Pickaxe (MUST be equipped)
  - Iron rocks found in mountain regions - look for "Iron Rock" in your observations
  - NOTE: Nisoc Rocks produce nisocore, NOT ironore - find the correct rock type
  - If no Iron Rocks visible at starting location, explore nearby mountain areas

⛏️ Mining - Coal:
  - harvest_resource on Coal Rock instances to get coal
  - Level required: 1+ (Mining skill)
  - Tool required: Pickaxe (MUST be equipped)
  - Coal rocks commonly found in mountain regions
  - Multiple pieces needed for smelting all iron ore

SMELTING OPERATIONS:
🔥 Smelting Recipe - ironbar:
  - craft_item skill=Smelting itemKey=ironbar
  - Materials: 1x ironore + 1x coal → 1x ironbar
  - Level required: 20 (uses Smithing skill level)
  - Need to produce multiple iron bars for all equipment

CRAFTING OPERATIONS:
🔨 Smithing Recipe - pickaxe:
  - craft_item skill=Smithing itemKey=pickaxe
  - Materials: 5x ironbar + 1x logs → 1x pickaxe
  - Level required: 5 (Smithing skill)

🔨 Smithing Recipe - axe:
  - craft_item skill=Smithing itemKey=axe
  - Materials: 3x ironbar + 1x logs → 1x axe
  - Level required: 3 (Smithing skill)

🔨 Smithing Recipe - sword2 (Heavy Sword):
  - craft_item skill=Smithing itemKey=sword2
  - Materials: 2x ironbar + 1x hilt2 → 1x heavy sword
  - Level required: 1 (Smithing skill)

🪵 Lumberjacking - logs:
  - harvest_resource on Oak Tree or Oak2 Tree instances to get logs
  - Level required: 1+ (Lumberjacking skill)
  - Tool required: Axe (MUST be equipped)
  - After calling harvest_resource, the process may take a few seconds to complete
  - Check your inventory after harvest to confirm logs were collected
  - Need logs for tool handles (pickaxe and axe crafting)

FIVE-AGENT TEAM ORGANIZATION:
- Agent 1: Primary Iron Miner - Focus on iron ore extraction
- Agent 2: Coal Miner & Fuel Specialist - Ensure adequate coal supply
- Agent 3: Master Smelter - Convert ore to bars efficiently
- Agent 4: Equipment Crafter - Produce all equipment pieces
- Agent 5: Logistics & Wood Gatherer - Collect logs and coordinate transfers

CRITICAL COORDINATION RULES:
- Announce inventory status after every major action in global chat
- Coordinate meeting points for efficient item transfers between all agents
- Track team progress: Iron ore collected, coal collected, bars smelted, equipment crafted
- Use verify_inventory frequently to ensure accurate resource tracking
- Work together to optimize the production pipeline

RESOURCE REQUIREMENTS (TOTAL):
- Iron ore: 10+ pieces (for smelting into bars)
- Coal: 10+ pieces (for smelting fuel)
- Logs: 3+ pieces (for tool handles)
- Iron bars: 10+ pieces (5 for pickaxe, 3 for axe, 2 for sword)

COMPLETION REQUIREMENTS:
- DO NOT use complete() until ALL equipment is crafted
- 1x pickaxe must be successfully crafted
- 1x axe must be successfully crafted
- 1x heavy sword must be successfully crafted
- All five agents must coordinate effectively throughout
- Equipment should be distributed to appropriate team members
success_criteria: IronMinerAlpha successfully mines iron ore and shares with team
CoalMinerBeta successfully mines coal and distributes for smelting
MasterSmelterGamma successfully smelts iron bars from ore and coal
EquipmentCrafterDelta successfully crafts pickaxe, axe, and heavy sword
LogisticsCoordinatorEpsilon successfully gathers logs and coordinates transfers
Team produces 1x pickaxe through coordinated effort
Team produces 1x axe through coordinated effort
Team produces 1x heavy sword through coordinated effort
All five agents coordinate effectively using global chat
Resources are shared efficiently among all team members
Team completes entire mining-to-crafting pipeline within time limit
All agents demonstrate effective five-agent coordination throughout operation
